purpose: Durable public WebAuthn credential owned by one Account; private key material never reaches DANTE and normal removal is logical revocation.

columns.name: passkey_credential_ref
columns.meaning: Stable DANTE row identity for this passkey credential.

columns.name: account_ref
columns.value_contract: Must already own a WebAuthnAccount user handle.

columns.name: credential_id
columns.meaning: WebAuthn credential identifier returned by the authenticator.

columns.name: credential_public_key
columns.meaning: Canonical COSE public key used to verify WebAuthn assertions.

columns.name: cose_algorithm
columns.meaning: COSE algorithm identifier bound to the credential public key.

columns.name: sign_count
columns.meaning: Largest accepted authenticator signature counter observed for this credential.

columns.name: backup_eligible
columns.meaning: WebAuthn backup-eligibility property established at registration.

columns.name: backup_state
columns.value_contract: May update after successful assertion; true requires backup_eligible=true.

columns.name: transports
columns.meaning: Bounded authenticator transport hints returned by WebAuthn.
columns.value_contract: At most 8 non-null strings; unknown future standardized values are preserved.

columns.name: label
columns.meaning: User-facing label for managing this passkey in Security settings.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.meaning: Latest persisted mutable credential state instant.

columns.name: last_used_at
columns.meaning: Latest successful assertion instant for this credential.
columns.value_contract: Null before first use; finite between created_at and updated_at when present.

columns.name: revoked_at
columns.meaning: Instant local logical removal became effective.

columns.name: revocation_reason_code
columns.meaning: Reviewed reason for passkey logical revocation.

foreign_keys.name: fk_passkey_credential_account_ref_webauthn_account
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: A passkey cannot exist for an Account that has no stable opaque WebAuthn user handle.

unique_constraints.name: uq_passkey_credential_credential_id
unique_constraints.reason: Database arbiter preventing one WebAuthn credential id from being registered twice or recycled after logical removal.

check_constraints.name: ck_passkey_credential_sign_count
check_constraints.reason: Persist the WebAuthn unsigned 32-bit signature counter domain without overflow/negative values.

check_constraints.name: ck_passkey_credential_transports
check_constraints.reason: Bound homogeneous transport hints without freezing future WebAuthn transport vocabulary.

check_constraints.name: ck_passkey_credential_backup_state
check_constraints.reason: A credential cannot be observed as backed up when it is not backup-eligible.

check_constraints.name: ck_passkey_credential_label
check_constraints.reason: Keep Security UI label bounded and meaningful.

check_constraints.name: ck_passkey_credential_chronology
check_constraints.expression_contract: finite created/updated and optional last-used chronology

check_constraints.name: ck_passkey_credential_revocation
check_constraints.expression_contract: active has no revocation fields; revoked has finite revoked_at <= updated_at and reason user_removed
check_constraints.reason: Make logical passkey removal complete and immutable enough to prevent silent credential reuse.

indexes.name: uq_passkey_credential_credential_id
indexes.reason: Credential resolution and lifetime uniqueness arbiter.

indexes.name: ix_passkey_credential_account_status
indexes.reason: Account authenticator listing and anti-lockout active-count lookup.

state_history.current_binding: One credential id remains bound to one Account for its DANTE lifetime; status controls current usability.
state_history.chronology: registered -> successful uses/counter-backup updates -> optional logical revoke.
state_history.immutability_policy: Account binding, credential_id, public key, COSE algorithm and backup_eligible are immutable; sign_count never decreases.

lifecycle.retention: Durable authenticator record retained after logical removal to prevent silent credential-id recycling.
lifecycle.redaction: Credential id/public key are security metadata; no private key, biometric template or authenticator PIN is stored.

obligations: M5 real PostgreSQL credential-id uniqueness, WebAuthn owner binding, backup-state validity, logical revocation and exact ACL proof
